jobs.title: Associate, Insurance Strategy and M&A Team
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW
The Insurance Strategy & M&A team at Global Atlantic is responsible for driving strategic growth initiatives, including inorganic expansion, corporate development, and strategic projects for the insurance business. The team works closely with senior leadership across Global Atlantic and KKR to evaluate and execute transactions and initiatives that enhance the company’s competitive positioning and long-term value creation.

Key areas of focus include (i) evaluating and executing acquisitions, partnerships, and reinsurance transactions, (ii) leading strategic initiatives across Global Atlantic’s insurance and asset management platform, (iii) assessing new business lines and growth opportunities, and (iv) supporting long-term strategic planning and capital deployment decisions.

POSITION OVERVIEW
Global Atlantic is seeking an Associate to join the Insurance Strategy & M&A team in New York. This role sits at the intersection of corporate development, strategy, and investing, with significant exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers across both Global Atlantic and KKR.

The Associate will play a key role in evaluating and executing M&A and strategic initiatives, including acquisitions that enhance the insurance business of KKR, reinsurance transactions, and internal strategic projects. This is a highly dynamic role suited for candidates interested in shaping the growth trajectory of a scaled insurance business.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Associate will be expected to:

- Support execution of transactions including acquisitions, partnerships, reinsurance and capital solutions

- Build and maintain detailed financial models to evaluate M&A transactions, reinsurance deals, and strategic initiatives

- Conduct industry research and competitive analysis across life insurance, retirement, and reinsurance markets

- Develop investment memos, presentations, and recommendations for senior leadership and investment committees

- Evaluate new market entry opportunities, product strategies, and business line expansions

- Partner with business leaders across KKR to drive internal strategic initiatives and operational improvements

- Assist in due diligence processes, including financial, operational, and regulatory workstreams

- Support long-term strategic planning, including capital allocation and growth prioritization

- Review and assess inbound opportunities from advisors, counterparties, and internal stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with KKR investment teams to evaluate opportunities that leverage the broader platform

QUALIFICATIONS

- 2–4 years of experience in investment banking (FIG preferred), private equity, corporate development, actuarial advisory or a related role

- Experience with insurance, reinsurance, or broader FIG strongly preferred

- Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with experience evaluating M&A transactions

- Demonstrated interest in insurance and long-term asset/liability-driven business models

- Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly and effectively to senior stakeholders

- High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment

- Aptitude for critical and creative thinking across the quantitative and qualitative spectrum

- Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflow

- Strong intellectual curiosity and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset

- Team-oriented with the ability to collaborate across functions and seniority levels

- Maturity, presence, sound judgment, and ability to form and express opinions and ideas effectively to cross-divisional teams including senior management

This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

$120,000 — $160,000 USD

jobs.title: Data Operations - Enterprise Market Data Strategy Lead
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Global Data Operations team is an enterprise data management and delivery organization focused on making the firm’s data more trusted, connected, actionable, and valuable. The team provides leverage across the full data lifecycle, from data sourcing and collection through data quality, enrichment, governance, reporting, and analytics. Working globally across KKR’s businesses and functions, Data Operations partners with stakeholders to translate complex data needs into scalable solutions, stronger operating processes, and high-quality insights that improve transparency, accelerate decision-making, and help the firm operate with greater speed, consistency, and intelligence.

Within Data Operations, KKR is establishing a new Enterprise Market Data Strategy capability to shape the future of one of the firm’s most critical information assets. This role will define and drive the firm-wide strategy for market data, partnering across businesses and functions to optimize investments, unlock greater value from data providers, and ensure market data capabilities evolve alongside KKR’s growth. The leader will influence commercial negotiations, steer enterprise-wide demand management, drive transparency into spending and usage, and build the operating model, reporting, and tools that enable smarter decision-making across the firm. Working at the intersection of strategy, data, finance, and operations, this role offers a unique opportunity to create a scalable market data ecosystem that enhances investment insight, improves efficiency, and delivers measurable enterprise value.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Principal, Enterprise Market Data Strategy to serve as the dedicated enterprise lead for market data strategy, execution, and optimization within KKR’s Global Data Operations organization. This is a newly created role designed to elevate a critical capability area — building a structured, enterprise-wide approach to KKR’s market data landscape, spanning hundreds of vendor relationships, thousands of product subscriptions, and millions of dollars in annual spend across multiple business lines and functions.

The scope of this role is strategic and cross-functional. The person in this seat will own KKR’s overall market data vision, build deep knowledge of the firm’s vendor and product ecosystem, develop a comprehensive enterprise inventory, drive demand management and optimization, create transparency around spend and utilization, and establish the governance cadences and decision-making processes needed to manage market data. They will partner actively with business COOs, Sourcing, Legal, FP&A, Technology, and Data Operations to connect insights across the organization, align market data investments with business priorities, and build a scalable enterprise capability that delivers measurable value across the firm.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the market data vendor and product ecosystem with the strategic orientation, executive presence, and cross-functional execution discipline required to operate as a senior leader at a world-class investment firm. This person understands financial services workflows, market data products and commercial models, vendor landscapes, and how investment professionals, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sourcing, and Data teams interact around market data decisions. They operate with the independence, judgment, and ownership expected at the Principal level — and they will treat this program as their own franchise to build.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own KKR’s enterprise market data strategy, including spend optimization, demand management, vendor rationalization, and alignment of market data investments with business priorities.

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive view of KKR’s market data landscape, including vendors, products, contracts, entitlements, usage, and spend.

- Lead evaluation and governance of market data demand, ensuring new requests, existing subscriptions, and vendor relationships deliver measurable business value and ROI.

- Serve as the business owner of the Calero platform, defining its vision, requirements, and operating model to provide enterprise-wide visibility into market data inventory, licensing, usage, and contracts.

- Partner with business leaders, COOs, FP&A, Sourcing, Legal, Technology, and Data Operations to understand needs, manage tradeoffs, and support strategic market data decisions across the firm.

- Drive transparency and accountability through reporting, budgeting, forecasting, renewal planning, and executive-level communications, including Market Data Steering Committee updates.

- Lead commercial optimization initiatives, including vendor consolidation, contract negotiations, license right-sizing, entitlement management, and other opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

- Ensure effective operational management of the market data ecosystem, including contract compliance, license governance, technology enablement, and support for scalable processes and controls.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8–12 years of experience in market data strategy, market data operations, data product management, vendor management, or related roles within financial services, market data providers, or information services firms.

- Deep knowledge of the market data ecosystem, including major providers such as Bloomberg, LSEG, FactSet, S&P Global, MSCI, ICE, and Moody’s, as well as their products, licensing models, commercial structures, and competitive positioning.

- Strong understanding of how market data is consumed across investment research, portfolio management, trading, risk, compliance, operations, and finance workflows.

- Experience managing enterprise market data platforms, inventories, entitlements, vendor catalogs, or related solutions such as Calero, TRG Screen, Alveo, or similar technologies.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate complex agreements, analyze usage and spend data, identify optimization opportunities, and build business cases that deliver measurable value.

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive enterprise initiatives in a highly matrixed environment, partnering effectively across business, technology, finance, sourcing, and legal teams.

- Experience establishing operating models, governance frameworks, reporting, and decision-making processes for enterprise data, technology, or market data programs.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop executive-level materials and present recommendations to senior leadership.

- Bachelor’s degree required.

- Collaborative, intellectually curious, commercially minded, and execution-oriented, with a commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience at a financial institution with $100B+ in AUM, or at a Tier 1 market data vendor in a strategic, product, or senior client-facing capacity.

- Familiarity with alternative asset management workflows, including private equity, credit, real assets, and insurance investment operations.

- Hands-on experience implementing or administering market data management tools (Calero, TRG Screen, MDSL, or equivalent) including data model design, inventory configuration, and reporting.

- Knowledge of market data regulatory and compliance requirements, including exchange audit processes, redistribution rules, and licensing restrictions.

- Experience with cost allocation methodologies for enterprise data and market data spend, and with enterprise budgeting and forecasting in a financial services context.

- MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline.

PREFERRED PROFILE

The ideal candidate is a market data expert who understands the market data ecosystem strategically—not just operationally. They have deep knowledge of market data products, vendors, licensing models, and consumption patterns across financial services, and a proven ability to identify opportunities to optimize costs, improve transparency, and maximize business value. They may come from a market data strategy, product, operations, or vendor management role at a leading financial institution or provider such as Bloomberg, LSEG, FactSet, S&P Global, MSCI, or ICE. Candidates from consulting backgrounds with significant market data advisory experience and a track record of driving enterprise transformation are also well suited.

In their first year, the successful candidate will establish a comprehensive view of KKR’s market data landscape, implement the foundational capabilities needed to manage vendors, contracts, entitlements, and spend at an enterprise level, and deliver measurable optimization opportunities and business value. They will become a trusted advisor to business leaders and the central driver of KKR’s market data strategy. Success in this role requires strong judgment, ownership, and execution, combined with the ability to operate independently and influence across a complex organization.
This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.
Base Salary Range
$185,000 — $230,000 USD

COMPANY OVERVIEW

TEAM OVERVIEW

The Global Treasury team manages liquidity, funding, and banking relationships across regions and business lines. The team partners closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure financial control, operational efficiency, and compliance while driving automation, integration, and continuous improvement across the firm’s global treasury infrastructure.

POSITION SUMMARY

The role is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day activities performed by the team, hiring, training, and establishing priorities. This role provides frequent exposure to various business leaders and the opportunity to drive impactful changes.

- The Assistant Vice President will lead treasury vertical(s) supporting global teams, oversee end-to-end operational processes, and play a pivotal role in driving strategic transformation initiatives.

- This individual will manage a high-performing team, lead key automation and system integration projects, and serve as a critical liaison across global Treasury, Finance, Operations, Technology, and external banking partners.

- The ideal candidate combines technical treasury expertise , project execution capability , and strong leadership and communication skills to influence outcomes across regions and functions.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Team Management

- Lead treasury operations vertical(s), ensuring delivery excellence, control adherence, and high performance.

- Coach, mentor, and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, high-accountability culture.

- Establish clear priorities, performance goals, and development plans aligned with global objectives.

Strategic Projects & Transformation

- Drive global treasury transformation initiatives including automation, process optimization, and system integrations.

- Partner with Technology and Operations teams to implement digital solutions improving efficiency, control, and scalability.

- Support global standardization of treasury processes and policies, embedding best practices across geographies.

Treasury Operations & Controls

- Own capital call and management fee reconciliation for private markets, including research and resolution of unidentified funds.

- Own FX reconciliation between counterparties and internal system and partnering with Technology to advance automation of this process.

- Own preparation of transfers between internal accounts and the capital call accounts.

- Maintain and reconcile cashbooks for funds on a monthly basis.

- Generate and maintain cash-balance and transaction reports (including via Hazeltree), including the weekly APAC cash balance report and transaction/position reports configured to stakeholder requirements.

- Own preparation of credit wires and partnering with Technology and Operations to transition this workflow to straight-through processing (STP).

- Oversee callback processes for funding beneficiaries and vendors across APAC, EMEA, and US regions.

- Review and certify funding beneficiaries on internal system.

- Overseeing and supporting third party admins operations as needed.

- Oversee maintenance of vendor banking details (including on behalf of Avega) in Coupa.

- Own audit requests related to PE funds reporting and FX reconciliation, ensuring timely and accurate responses.

Stakeholder Management

- Partner with global Treasury leadership, leadership across functions, fund controllers, and technology teams to align on priorities and deliverables.

- Act as a key point of escalation for issues and ensure timely resolution.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with external banking partners and counterparties.

- Collaborate across regions (U.S., EMEA, APAC) to deliver consistent, high-quality treasury services.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline; professional certification (e.g., CTP, CFA, CA, CPA) preferred.

- 10–12 years of experience in treasury, cash management, or financial operations within a global financial institution or asset manager.

- Proven experience leading teams and managing global processes or projects.

- Strong understanding of treasury workflows, accounting principles, and risk control frameworks.

- Experience with treasury systems and tools such as S4Hana, Coupa, Workiva, Hazeltree, Smartsheet, and Excel is preferred, not mandatory.

- Demonstrated success driving automation, process transformation, or system integration

- Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across senior leadership levels.

- Ability to work across time zones with a global mindset , balancing strategic priorities with operational rigor.

- High integrity, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

- Collaborative: Builds trust and alignment across teams and regions.

jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

KKR REAL ESTATE CREDIT AND K-STAR INVESTMENT SERVICES OVERVIEW

KKR Real Estate Credit was formed in January 2015 to invest in real estate credit products and launched the European Real Estate Credit business in 2022. The KKR Real Estate Credit platform complements KKR Real Estate’s private equity platforms and seeks opportunities where we have a sourcing, underwriting or execution advantage by leveraging KKR’s brand, industry knowledge and relationships. KKR Real Estate Credit currently invests through 8 separately capitalized vehicles across our Direct Lending and Securities portfolios and consists of 120+ dedicated professionals based in New York, San Francisco, Houston, Dallas and London.

In 2022, KKR created K-Star Asset Management LLC (“K-Star”), a dedicated investment services platform based in Dallas, Texas.  The K-Star team includes industry specialists overseeing asset management, loan origination, securities investing, risk management and client experience for KKR’s global real estate credit franchise. In 2024, K-Star established an office in Dublin, supporting KKR’s real estate credit portfolio across Western Europe.

POSITION OVERVIEW

K-Star’s Finance and Accounting team oversees the firm’s accounting and reporting matters to produce analytical insights that drive business decisions and long-term success. The team is responsible for designing efficient frameworks through internal and external data and reports to understand the market environment and business dynamics, and to implement best practices. The team also collaborates closely with K-Star’s Securities, Direct Lending, and Asset-Backed Finance teams to ensure accurate reporting and budgeting of revenue as well as modeling other analytics. The Finance and Accounting team also works closely with various K-Star teams and KKR’s accounting team to report in a timely manner and to respond to ad-hoc requests. The successful candidate must be an exceptional communicator with a goal towards action, possess advanced analytical and modeling skills, thrive on creative problem-solving, and be skilled at building strong partnerships across the various KKR lines of business.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Excellence

- Prepare an annual budget, and provide oversight of the periodic financial forecasting, on a stand-alone entity basis

- Assist in driving continuous improvement to systems and processes cross-functionally across the organization to ensure alignment with strategic initiatives

- Integral contributor in the overall operating model of K-Star which supports key initiatives and strategic long-range planning and growth objectives

- Create models to assist in analyzing key performance indicators across the various K-Star business lines

- Produce monthly and quarterly reports relating to K-Star’s performance and goals for internal stakeholders

- Collaborate with Securities and Direct Lending teams to support the collection and reconciliation of servicing fee revenue utilizing various systems (such as Hazeltree treasury tool and Special Servicing RealINSIGHT solution)

- Assist the European finance team in reporting fee revenue and preparing financial reports consistent with KKR’s established protocol and format

- Track, monitor and analyze expense spending for detailed reporting to Senior Management

- Improve and/or develop financial models, and infrastructure, to support the evolving needs of the business

- Complete ad hoc projects for K-Star and the broader KKR enterprise

Stakeholder Management

- Serve as point of contact for clients, vendors, finance teams and all other stakeholders related to K-Star’s finance functions

- Maintain working relationship with investment teams, providing relevant and timely communication

- Work closely with K-Star business teams and KKR Accounting team

- Interact with all levels of Senior Management

Reporting & Governance

- Assist in completion of the quarterly financial overview

- Prepare slide-decks and manage reporting projects

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's Degree preferably in a Finance, Accounting or Business-related course of study, or equivalent experience. MBA or CPA Preferred

- Minimum 4 years of experience in similar role, in a multinational financial services organization with exposure to real estate, servicing and/or asset management is preferred

- Superior analytical and financial modeling skills; ability to create, build and enhance models and other technology tools

- Understanding of business processes for accounting and finance functions

- Excellent organizational and communication skills, both verbal and written

- Exceptional attention to detail and thoroughness is required to ensure accuracy in all data and work product

- High proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Knowledge S4Hana preferred

- High intellectual curiosity and an innovative mindset

- Strong sense of integrity and accountability

- A focus on delivering excellence

- Team-work orientation, collaboration, and relationship building skills with all key stakeholders

- Ability to work independently in a way that reflects the firm’s culture and core values

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Analyst - Insurance Liquidity Forecast
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

The Treasury Operations team supports a wide range of Treasury Operations functions for the insurance business, working collaboratively across Banks, the Investment Team, Third Party Administrators (TPA), Risk Management, and Accounts Payable to manage liquidity and cash activity across multiple legal entities.

POSITION SUMMARY

The successful Analyst must manage responsibilities in a fast-paced environment for multiple legal entities while accommodating enhancements to the existing functions to meet the rapidly changing needs of the business.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Perform daily liquidity management processes supporting operations and investment activity by working collaboratively with Banks, Global Atlantic's Investment Team, Third Party Administrators (TPA), Risk Management, and Accounts Payable

- Perform daily review of forecasted items, comparing actual performance to previous forecasts, identify discrepancies and investigate root cause

- Support core daily activity including accounting, cash reconciliations, operational reporting, and bank account management

- Review and develop analyses, trending reports, and identify deviations from the norm

- Contribute to identifying process improvements and participate in company-wide initiatives/projects to improve processes and infrastructure

- Explore and apply AI tools to enhance personal productivity and drive innovation in team processes

QUALIFICATIONS

- Undergraduate degree required with a minimum of 2 years work experience in a Treasury or Financial Operations role

- Knowledge of treasury systems (i.e. treasury workstations, bank web portals) a strong plus

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, strongly required

- Prior experience supporting financial controls in compliance with SOX a strong plus

- Prior experience in insurance industry a strong plus

- Strong analytical and problem solving skills

- Ability to multi-task and manage multiple responsibilities

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

- Learning agility with strong intellectual curiosity and a drive to continuously grow

- Self-starter who takes initiative and proactively addresses issues that may impact the outcome of initiatives

- Innovative mindset, open to using and innovating with AI to improve personal productivity and team processes

- Ability to identify, communicate, and resolve key issues

- Positive attitude even when faced with difficult obstacles, issues or challenges

- Commercial mindset with an entrepreneurial spirit

- Comfort using AI-powered tools to improve productivity and quality of work

- Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows

- Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance

jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Director, Individual Markets Insurance Operations, the Service Leader of Agency and New Business Experience function — setting operational priorities, managing vendor partnerships, driving team effectiveness, and aligning sales strategy with operational execution to deliver pipeline performance. This leader will evolve the team's focus from transaction processing toward exception intelligence, process improvement, and firm experience, continuously improving operational efficiency through smarter processes and technology while elevating the value the team delivers to firms and financial professionals. This position is based in Hartford, CT or Des Moines, IA.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead daily new business and agency operations, delivering exception resolution quality, service level attainment, issuance velocity, productivity, and customer outcomes aligned with business objectives and process improvement priorities.

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team by setting clear performance expectations, building analytical and exception-handling capability, managing capacity, and fostering accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.

- Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operating rhythms — reviewing exception volumes, automation fallout trends, service levels, quality, workload distribution, aging, and operational risks — and drive timely corrective actions.

- Monitor exception volumes and processing trends, partnering with Domain, Product Owner, and Technology teams to refine workflows so the team can focus its expertise on the cases that most benefit from hands-on attention.

- Partner with Third-Party Administrators (TPAs) and vendor partners to ensure operational execution, service quality, and productivity align with business expectations and firm experience standards.

- Lead resolution of operational issues, firm complaints, complex cases, and escalations, ensuring timely follow-through and positive outcomes for firms and financial professionals.

- Implement operational improvements that strengthen quality, reduce recurring exceptions, improve efficiency, and enhance team capability as the team modernizes its processes and tools.

- Partner with Sales Operations Support to ensure daily operational priorities reflect firm expectations, reduce escalation volume, and reinforce an ownership mindset across the team.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- 10+ years of experience in insurance, financial services, or new business/agency operations, including 5+ years in a people leadership role.

- Demonstrated experience managing vendor or TPA relationships and driving SLA performance.

- Working knowledge of automation and workflow tools (e.g., Pega), with insurance and regulatory knowledge relevant to new business issuance and agency operations.

- Preferred: experience leading operational transformation from manual/transactional processing toward exception-based, technology-enabled service models.

- Preferred: familiarity with sales operations, distribution, or agency management structures.

- Preferred: industry designations such as FLMI, LOMA, or ACS.

CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS

- People leadership and coaching — builds high-performing, accountable teams and coaches with a growth mindset.

- Data-driven performance management — uses metrics, exception trends, and operating rhythms to run the business and drive corrective action.

- Vendor and TPA management — sets SLA expectations, monitors performance, and holds partners accountable to firm experience standards.

- Sales-Operations alignment — partners with Distribution and Sales Operations to translate firm expectations into operational priorities.

- Cross-pod planning and dependency management — orchestrates work across Domain, Product, and Technology to advance process and automation improvements.

- Insurance and regulatory acumen — brings working knowledge of new business issuance, agency operations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Operational transformation mindset — shifts teams from production-based work toward analytical, relationship-based, and exception-focused work.

- Trust-based partnership and communication — removes barriers, addresses issues proactively, and builds credibility across functions.
